descriptionChirho: Qal sense of being in a state of lacking, needing, or being without something, whether present, past, or future
Qal sense of becoming less or receding in quantity, as of waters or resources diminishing over time
Piel intensive-causative sense of actively making someone lower in status or depriving someone of something
Hifil causative sense of causing a lack or withholding something so that it becomes deficient
